title: Customer order totals
statement_markdown: Return every customer name and their total order amount. Customers without orders must appear with total 0. Order by customer name.
hints: Use COALESCE around the aggregate result.
explanation: LEFT JOIN preserves customers without matches. Group per customer and turn the missing sum into zero.
reference_solution: SELECT c.name, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) AS total FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY c.name;
complexity: Depends on join strategy; an index on orders.customer_id supports the join.
